mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent earnings downgrades.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent earnings upgrades.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals an impending monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not precede tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, the combination signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high UNRATE and declining PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent consumer spending growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, the combination signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low GDP growth and declining INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent earnings downgrades.
